provenance: Sandbox one-off primary checks issued live on 2026-09-19 against api.fda.gov, accessdata.fda.gov (Drugs@FDA) and fda.gov (FDA History). Each entry records the exact request URL and the verbatim excerpt relied on; nothing is paraphrased into a fact. Bulk per-row probes for the same years were fetched by the repository's GitHub Actions collector (fetch_jobs/pre1980_row_probes_1965_1976.json, fetch_jobs/pre1980_year_populations_1965_1976.json) and are committed verbatim with SHA-256 under data/raw/.

captures.subject: NDA019853 Cuprimine (penicillamine) - 1970 numbering anomaly, verbatim ORIG block
captures.finding: meta.results.total = 1. The record carries exactly one ORIG submission: ORIG-1 / AP / 19701204 / STANDARD / TYPE 1 - New Molecular Entity, sponsor VALEANT PHARMS INTL, brand CUPRIMINE, generic PENICILLAMINE. Supplements run 1987-2004, so the application has existed under this number since well before those dates. The application number 019853 is out of sequence for a 1970 approval (1970-era numbers in the same payload block run 0167xx-0169xx): flagged as an FDA-data numbering anomaly, the date is NOT adjusted.
captures.verbatim_excerpt: { "submission_type": "ORIG", "submission_number": "1", "submission_status": "AP", "submission_status_date": "19701204", "review_priority": "STANDARD", "submission_class_code": "TYPE 1", "submission_class_code_description": "Type 1 - New Molecular Entity" } ... "application_number": "NDA019853", "sponsor_name": "VALEANT PHARMS INTL", "openfda": { "brand_name": [ "CUPRIMINE" ], "generic_name": [ "PENICILLAMINE" ], "manufacturer_name": [ "Bausch Health US, LLC" ], "product_ndc": [ "25010-705" ] }
captures.project_effect: confirms the payload date/class/priority live and records the out-of-sequence application-number anomaly on the row

captures.subject: Amikacin (Amikin) NDA050495 - gap-candidate probe for the 1976 shortfall
captures.finding: meta.results.total = 1: the application IS in openFDA (sponsor APOTHECON, two AMIKIN amikacin sulfate injectable products, both Discontinued, both reference drugs) but the record has NO submissions array at all. An application with no submissions can never satisfy submissions.submission_type:ORIG AND submissions.submission_status:AP, which is exactly why amikacin is absent from every committed 1965-1979 ORIG/AP payload despite NCATS Inxight recording it as first approved in 1976.
captures.verbatim_excerpt: "results": [ { "application_number": "NDA050495", "sponsor_name": "APOTHECON", "products": [ { "product_number": "001", "reference_drug": "Yes", "brand_name": "AMIKIN", "active_ingredients": [ { "name": "AMIKACIN SULFATE", "strength": "EQ 50MG BASE/ML **Federal Register determination that product was not discontinued or withdrawn for safety or effectiveness reasons**" } ], "reference_standard": "No", "dosage_form": "INJECTABLE", "route": "INJECTION", "marketing_status": "Discontinued" }, { "product_number": "002", ... "EQ 250MG BASE/ML" ... } ] } ] - no "submissions" key present.
captures.project_effect: names the 1976 gap candidate and proves the invisibility mechanism; the row is NOT added to the decision table because FDA publishes no approval date, class or priority for it

captures.subject: NDA013664 Gantanol suspension - the earlier same-ingredient Type 5 sibling
captures.finding: One Original Approval row: 07/01/1965, ORIG-1, Approval, Type 5 - New Formulation or New Manufacturer, STANDARD (Company: ROCHE), single product GANTANOL sulfamethoxazole 500MG/5ML oral suspension. captures.subject: NDA017690 Imodium - same-day Type 5 twin of the 1976 Type 1 row
captures.finding: meta.results.total = 1. NDA017690 (holder J AND J CONSUMER INC) publishes ORIG-1/AP/19761228/STANDARD/TYPE 5 with the IDENTICAL product string as the Type 1 row NDA017694 (IMODIUM, LOPERAMIDE HYDROCHLORIDE 2MG, CAPSULE, ORAL, Discontinued) - two applications, one product, one date. FDA's 2016 labeling letter for SUPPL-5 is filed as '017690Orig1s005,017694Orig1s052ltr.pdf', covering both applications, which confirms they are a linked pair. Loperamide therefore counts once, via the Type 1 row.
